user.title: Choose a data source
user.description:
**NDW** (Netherlands only)
- ✅ Live availability per connector type
- ✅ Exact tariffs incl. VAT, straight from the operator
- ✅ No account or API key needed
- ⚠️ Downloads ~5 MB on every refresh (up to about 1.4 GB per day)

**Open Charge Map** (worldwide)
- ✅ Also works outside the Netherlands
- ✅ Light on data traffic (a few kB)
- ⚠️ Needs a free API key
- ⚠️ No live occupancy: only whether a point has been reported as working
- ⚠️ Community data that may be outdated; prices are free text

api_key.title: Open Charge Map API key
api_key.description: Create a free account and request an API key on the [Open Charge Map API page]({api_url}).

ndw_confirm.title: Download NDW data?
ndw_confirm.description:
To show live availability the integration downloads a nationwide NDW file: **~5 MB** (~41 MB unpacked). NDW offers no regional filter, so the whole file is needed.

- **Now:** a one-off download to search your area.
- **After that:** again on every refresh (every 5 minutes by default, up to about 1.4 GB per day). You choose the interval shortly.
- **Prices** come from a separate file (~4 MB) fetched at most once per day.

On a metered connection, Open Charge Map is the better choice.

location_method.title: Where to search?
location_method.description: Choose how to give the search location.

postcode.title: Search around a postcode
postcode.description: With a house number the search is around that address, without one around the middle of the postcode.

map.title: Search around a point
map.description: Move the pin and set the radius. The pin starts at your home location.

select.title: Choose charging locations
select.description: Sorted by distance, with current availability, power and price when known. {hidden}

interval_ndw.title: Refresh
interval_ndw.description: How often should availability be refreshed? Every refresh downloads ~5 MB: at 5 minutes that is up to about 1.4 GB per day. Minimum {minimum} seconds. Prices are refreshed at most once per day.

interval_ocm.title: Refresh
interval_ocm.description: How often should the data be fetched? OCM data rarely changes, so a low frequency is fine. Minimum {minimum} seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Open Charge Map API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key is no longer accepted. Request a new one on the [Open Charge Map API page]({api_url}).

interval_api.title: Refresh
interval_api.description: How often should availability be refreshed? Every refresh asks NDW only for your locations: a few kB. Minimum {minimum} seconds. Prices are refreshed at most once per day.
